name: Ministry of Transport of the People's Republic of China
sub: Scores operators on driverless mileage and critical interventions
leadership: Verify current public leadership before outreach
about: Central transport ministry relevant to autonomous road transport, taxi services, road operations and freight deployment. Permits progress through staged gates, safety-driver testing, then driverless testing, then free public service, then paid commercial operation, with operators judged on total mileage, driverless mileage, miles per critical intervention and miles per accident.
model: Transport policy, road transport rules, passenger/freight oversight and safety coordination.
deployment: China national and provincial/municipal transport bureaus.
metrics: Permits, rules, reporting or type-approval authority relevant to AV deployment.
signal: Central and local authorities intensified safety oversight of intelligent connected vehicle testing in 2026.
